messages:
sara: Quick sync — Cerulex dedicated bring-up tomorrow 10:00 PT. Need final quota numbers, autoscale knobs, and who owns the smoke/load tests. Also flagging renewal risk if onboarding slips past next-week SLA. 

mike: Ack. Infra looked green but need expected QPS/concurrency to size min_replicas and burst. Do we have a target p95 latency? :eyes: 

sara: Baseline ~150 RPS, burst up to ~500 RPS for short windows. Target p95 <= 250ms for gen endpoint. Traffic profile: 70% short queries (<=64 tokens), 30% long (<=512). 

devin: Model variant will be redwood/llama-compat-small:v2 (quantized). I'll precompile kernels and push a primed snapshot. KV cache warmup script at: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/cerulex/priming.md — uses our batcher + prefix cache. 

elaine: I can own smoke + functional validation. Please drop the runbook link + service account for logs access. Suggest a 30m ramp window then 1h soak. 

mike: Suggested autoscale policy (temp):
```json
{
  "min_replicas": 2,
  "max_replicas": 8,
  "scale_up_threshold_rps": 120,
  "scale_down_threshold_rps": 40,
  "cooldown_s": 60
}
```
Adjustable based on test results. Ops: will we allow burst overcommit for the first 2 hours? 

opsbot: Reminder: Cerulex bring-up scheduled in 18 hours. Please confirm runbook/owners 12h before window. (automated) :bell: 

sara: Renewal note: customer exec mentioned go-live readiness tied to SLA next Thursday. If we miss the warmup, we'll trigger AM outreach — flags to renewals. Elaine, can you escalate if we hit >20% error rate during smoke? 

elaine: Yes, will escalate to @sara and @mike. I need temporary quota bump for the warmup to mimic production — request +20% for 2h. Also need a contact at Cerulex for CORS/account keys: contact@cerulex.com? 

mike: Approved +20% for 2h starting at ramp. I'll annotate the run with metrics collection (token cost, p95/p99, error-rate, GPU util). Please include the load profile. 

devin: Load harness command (k6):
```bash
k6 run --vus 200 --duration 10m scripts/cerulex-gen-test.js --out influxdb=http://metrics:8086
```
Script lives in repo: git://infra/load-scripts/cerulex-gen-test.js 

elaine: Post-run quick notes: smoke passed ✅ Primed KV cache, tail lat p95=180ms, p99=420ms during a single spike, error-rate 0.4%. Logs + traces: https://s3.redwood/cerulex/warmup-2026-03-22-10am.zip. Leaving the pool in steady state now. 

sara: Amazing — thanks team. Filing a short enablement note for the CSM: https://redwood.internal/csm/notes/cerulex-2026-03-22. We'll monitor next 24h and update renewal risk if anything degrades. :thumbsup: 

mike: I'll keep alerts tuned — will revert autoscale to normal after the 2h window. If anyone sees >1% errors, ping me immediately. 

elaine: Closing the loop: owner=elaine for smoke, devin for priming artifacts, mike for autoscale/ops. I'll post results to the account thread and close this.
